Risk Description:
Current or potential impact
on earnings or capital
arising from the Bank’s
inability to meet its liabilities
/ financial obligations as and
when they fall due, or fund
increases in assets without
incurring unacceptable costs
or losses.
Assessment:
• Liquidity KRIs, statutory
liquidity ratios, advances
to deposits ratios, the
quality of maturity
analysis of its cash-
flows from a time bucket
perspective are regularly
reported and reviewed at
ALCO & BARC.
Treasury department
manages this risk on a daily
basis using some of the
above techniques in addition
to daily cash-flow forecasts
for its decisions.
Mitigation:
Assets funded by adequate liquidity
Projects cashflow per currency type
Monitors KRIs against internal and regulatory
guidelines.
Maintains a diverse array and range of funding
sources as contingencies.
Manage concentrations to avoid reliance
on large individual depositors and ensure a
satisfactory funding mix is attained.
Invest in short term liquid instruments, which
can easily be sold in secondary markets in need.
Ensure investments in large cash outlay projects
are budgeted for, and carried out from liquid
cash flows.
• Maintain liquidity and funding contingency
plans and KRIs that clearly identify early
stress conditions and describe actions to be
taken in events of difficulties arising from
systemic or funding crisis, while minimising
adverse long-term implications.
